items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the ring of global functions on a normal integral algebraic space is a normal domain (statement lines 538-542). The proof (proof lines 544-563) shows first that the ring is a domain, then reduces normality to the integrality of elements of the fraction field, solves the corresponding equation locally over affine etale neighbourhoods whose rings of sections are normal domains, and glues by a uniqueness argument based on reducedness. H2: a three-step argument with three inputs, written out in full.
